scenario: AITA for massaging my guy friend in front of his girlfriend? | I (32F) met my friend (30M) at work last year. We hang out a lot the three of us and I love both of them now, even if I knew him first. Today, we were hanging out at the beach for the fireworks and my guy friend was in a bad mood. Was I being an asshole here?
